headlines.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
headlines.summary: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg. That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion.

concept.title: Fine-tuning vs Prompting
concept.body: Prompting steers a general model with instructions; fine-tuning retrains it on your examples. Prompting is faster and cheaper; fine-tuning suits narrow, repeated jobs.
concept.takeaway: Exhaust prompting and RAG before paying for fine-tuning — most needs never require it.
